pages.title: Repeat and queue
pages.text: Repeat supports Off, Current Sound and Playlist.$(br2)Queued requests play once and interrupt a repeating sound.$(br2)Old Loop settings migrate to Current Sound repeat.

pages.title: Seeking and restart
pages.text: Restart begins the current sound at zero.$(br2)Stop resets its position.$(br2)Jump accepts minutes:seconds, such as 1:30.$(br2)Unknown-duration streams cannot seek.

pages.title: Request ordering
pages.text: Play Next inserts a request at the front; Add to Queue appends.$(br2)Clearing the queue leaves saved playlists intact.$(br2)Requests run before the saved source resumes.
